1.name: A World We Drew
1.overview: Young Hane starts at a new school, where he meets Aishi, an unusual boy who soon becomes his first true friend. As the two grow closer, they escape into worlds of their own creation through drawings and imagination. Their innocent friendship marks the beginning of a bond that will shape both of their lives.

overview:
HANE KAGE: VEILED is a psychological mystery animated series about friendship, identity, memory, and supernatural phenomena.

Years after his childhood friend Hane Kage mysteriously disappears, Aishi returns to the old Kage family mansion seeking answers. There, he encounters a boy claiming to be Hane and learns that his forgotten diary may hold the key to his disappearance. As a mysterious Shadow begins revealing buried memories and emotions, Aishi must uncover the truth behind his friend's fate before it is lost forever.
tagline: When buried emotions finally take shape
